title: Azusawa Kohane — A Quick Breather〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Have a seat at that empty table over there. Will iced tea work for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome and Aoyagi are not here yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I think they should be here soon, though.
Probably just being delayed by homeroom.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, welcome!
Take a seat there, I'll bring you a drink...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He received a phone call just before I walked in. He's talking on the phone outside now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello, Shinonome.
How was your phone call?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ah, well, since we're all here, I should let everyone know.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Remember the time I mentioned we may be invited to a huge event? I just received an official invitation just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-That's amazing...
We only just started performing as a group not too long ago...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito knows a lot of people. He often gets invitations to such events. I think he knows the organizer for the event this time as well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's a gathering of new artists based in Shibuya.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here's the list of currently confirmed performers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I guess I shouldn't be surprised to see so many talented rookie groups on the list for such a large event.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was really nervous about the event being so big, but I'm relieved to hear it's for rookies only.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We're the special guests of this event.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That means...we're the highlight of the event, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um... Shinonome?
Aren't we considered rookies too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Toya and I have been performing since middle school.
We're not rookies.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And she's pretty well-known as well just for being Ken's daughter.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They've all performed in many events before...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I can count the number of times I've performed on a stage with two hands...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm not good enough to be a special guest...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? Ah, I'm sorry...
I'm just not sure...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha, don't worry!
You'll be fine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She's right. You have what it takes, so don't be unsure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I felt uneasy because I'm the only one without much experience.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if you think I'll be fine, then I guess it's okay for me to have a little more confidence in myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Just so we're clear, I didn't sign up for the event without thinking because it's big and we're special guests.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I wouldn't have accepted the invite if I didn't feel like we were up to the task. In the first place, I wouldn't team up with someone I didn't acknowledge.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Now that that's settled, we need to think of what songs to sing! You have anything in mind, Kohane?
